title: Oscar and the Bakery
author: Quentin Villalobos
blurb: Coral Okafor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
